```{=html}
<nav class="section-tabs" aria-label="Publications pages">
  <a href="index.html">Overview</a>
  <a href="party-politics.html">This too in moderation: data</a>
  <a href="eup.html">Party group collapse: data</a>
  <a href="video-games.html">Video games database</a>
</nav>
<script>
  (() => {
    const norm = p => p.replace(/index\.html$/, "").replace(/\/$/, "");
    const here = norm(location.pathname);
    document.querySelectorAll(".section-tabs a").forEach(a => {
      if (norm(new URL(a.getAttribute("href"), location.href).pathname) === here) a.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
    });
  })();
</script>
```
